notes: CBER website-review letter (no facility inspection) for an HIV dried-blood-spot self-collection test kit marketed without a PMA/IDE and without 510(k) notification, charged as adulterated (501(f)(1)(B)) and misbranded (502(o)). The kit is referred to only by the generic descriptor 'HIV DBS card self-collection kit' throughout -- no distinct brand/model name is ever given -- so products is left empty rather than guessing a name; not marked product_redacted since it isn't a (b)(4) redaction, just no branded name used. HIV is referenced only as a disease/test target, not a genus-species organism, so organisms is empty. No FEI or facility location is stated (website review only).
